title: BlockBlast
desc: BlockBlast is a classic block game suitable for all ages. It is extremely easy to learn, but achieving high scores can be very challenging. Drag the generated blocks from each round into the grid.
howto: BlockBlast is a classic block game suitable for all ages
It is extremely easy to learn, but achieving high scores can be very challenging
Drag the generated blocks from each round into the grid
tips: Work from the corners — they constrain the board the most.
Plan two moves ahead before committing.
